post.news: Argos hired Richard Ayoade to add humour to its 2026 Christmas ad.
post.take: Nothing says festive cheer quite like paying a deadpan comedian to look mildly annoyed by your catalogue.
post.insight: Using a distinct comedic voice cuts through the holiday noise better than another generic family dinner scene.
